extracted.intended_audience: registered patent practitioners (attorneys/agents), Office of Enrollment and Discipline staff, and attorneys subject to USPTO discipline
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and substantive rules governing imposition of reciprocal discipline (exclusion from practice before the USPTO) based on a state court disbarment, including service, opportunity to respond, findings, and sanctions under 37 C.F.R. § 11.24 and related provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basis for exclusion (violation of 37 C.F.R. § 11.804(h))
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent is excluded from practice before the USPTO for violation of 37 C.F.R. § 11.804(h), predicated upon being disbarred from the practice of law by a duly constituted authority of a State.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order states the exclusion is based on the Illinois Supreme Court disbarment in In re: Michael David Gerhardt, M.R. 028479. The Notice of Exclusion language describes the predicate state disciplinary findings supporting the USPTO action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reciprocal discipline under 37 C.F.R. § 11.24
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director may request that the USPTO impose reciprocal discipline identical to that imposed by a state court under 37 C.F.R. § 11.24.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A Notice and Order pursuant to § 11.24 is mailed to the respondent and provides an opportunity to file a response opposing identical reciprocal discipline based on the limited reasons enumerated in § 11.24(d)(1). Absent a successful showing under § 11.24(d)(1), reciprocal discipline is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service of Notice per 37 C.F.R. § 11.11(a) and publication if undelivered
rubrics_metrics.description: The Notice and Order must be mailed by certified mail to the most recent address provided pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.11(a). If the Notice is not able to be delivered, it is published in the Official Gazette.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Order describes certified mail receipt numbers and notes that because the Notice was not deliverable it was published in the Official Gazette on specified dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunity to respond within 40 days (timing requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Notice and Order provided Respondent an opportunity to file, within forty (40) days, a response opposing the imposition of reciprocal discipline identical to the discipline imposed by the state court.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Respondent may attempt to show one or more of the reasons in 37 C.F.R. § 11.24(d)(1) to oppose identical discipline. Failure to timely respond may lead to a determination that there is no genuine issue of material fact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of failure to respond (no genuine issue of material fact)
rubrics_metrics.description: In light of Respondent's failure to file a response, the USPTO determines there is no genuine issue of material fact under 37 C.F.R. § 11.24(d) and that exclusion is the appropriate discipline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This establishes that non-response supports entry of reciprocal discipline without further factual dispute when the procedural requirements are met.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required content and publication of Notice of Exclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director must publish a Notice in the Official Gazette materially consistent with the provided 'NOTICE OF EXCLUSION' text describing the respondent, registration number, basis for exclusion, and the underlying state-court findings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The model Notice includes a plain-English summary of the state-court findings, the specific state rules violated, and references to the statutory/regulatory authority (35 U.S.C. § 32 and 37 C.F.R. § 11.24).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific misconduct findings (state rules violated) as grounds for reciprocal discipline
rubrics_metrics.description: The state court found respondent violated specific Illinois Rules of Professional Conduct (IRPC) — IRPC 1.1, 1.3, 1.4(a)(3) and (4), 1.15(d), 1.16(d), and 8.4(c) — based on failures such as not distributing settlement funds, failing to prepare/appear, not keeping clients informed, making false statements, and not refunding unearned fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Notice recites two matters with factual summaries linking the misconduct to each cited IRPC rule; those findings form the factual predicate for USPTO reciprocal discipline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory and regulatory authority for action
rubrics_metrics.description: This action is taken pursuant to the provisions of 35 U.S.C. § 32 and 37 C.F.R. § 11.24.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Citing the controlling statute and regulation clarifies the USPTO's authority to impose reciprocal discipline and to publish the decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice to state disciplinary agencies and courts per 37 C.F.R. § 11.59
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director must give notice pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.59 of the public discipline and the reasons for the discipline to disciplinary enforcement agencies in the state(s) where the respondent is admitted, to courts where respondent is known to be admitted, and to the public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Order requires OED to inform relevant state agencies and courts of the discipline, ensuring reciprocal/public awareness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respondent duties upon discipline per 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent shall comply with the duties enumerated in 37 C.F.R. § 11.58.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While the order does not restate § 11.58, it incorporates by reference the post-discipline duties (e.g., notification and other obligations) that disciplined practitioners must follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dissociation from USPTO Customer Numbers and PKI certificates
rubrics_metrics.description: The USPTO shall dissociate Respondent's name from any Customer Numbers and the public key infrastructure (PKI) certificate associated with those Customer Numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an operational sanction to prevent the disciplined individual's continued use of USPTO electronic/customer credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on applying for or obtaining a USPTO Customer Number until reinstated
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent shall not apply for a USPTO Customer Number, shall not obtain a USPTO Customer Number, nor shall his name be added to a USPTO Customer Number, unless and until he is reinstated to practice before the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This bars the disciplined person from reestablishing electronic filing or representation capabilities at the USPTO until formal reinstatement occurs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication and public availability of disciplinary decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Disciplinary decisions are available for public review at the Office of Enrollment and Discipline's FOIA Reading Room (URL provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Order directs where the public and interested parties can access the decision and similar disciplinary records.
